why_agent_cannot: a wallet connection or signature is required
what_human_must_do: Start from fhenix.io and use only the links on it, including @fhenix on X. The games run on outside hosts such as vercel.app and onrender.com, so open them from Fhenix's own pages.
For credits, open onlyfhens.fhenix.io, connect a wallet and an X account, and do the three required quests. The post and video quests unlock after that.
For shop credits, play one of the listed games with one wallet, then sign in to the shop with that same wallet.
After 21 October, watch @fhenix for the first mainnet apps. Fhenix hasn't published any steps for users yet.
costs: Everything here is free to try. Testnet demos need only free test ETH. risks: You must be 18 or older. The terms exclude anyone in or from Cuba, Iran, North Korea, Russia, Syria and Belarus, and anyone on UN, US, EU, UK or Israeli sanctions lists. VPNs are banned: "You may not use a VPN, proxy, false identity, or other technical or deceptive means for the purpose of circumventing geographic, sanctions, eligibility, or access restrictions."
